name: Schmidt Equipment & Supply
old_description: The Schmidt Family has been in the meat and food processing industry since 1943 when Roy Elias Schmidt and his partner, Leo Welch, opened The Schmidt-Welch Equipment Company to rebuild and service equipment in the St. Louis area during WWII. A few years later, Roy bought out his partner, and the company name was changed to Roy E. Schmidt Sales & Service Co.
about:
Schmidt Equipment & Supply traces its roots to 1943 in St. Louis, Missouri, when Roy Elias Schmidt and Leo Welch founded the Schmidt‑Welch Equipment Company to rebuild and service meat‑processing machinery during World War II. Welch soon sold his share to Schmidt, and the firm became Roy E. Schmidt Sales & Service Co. The business has remained in the Schmidt family for three generations.

Today the company operates as a single‑source distributor and service provider for the meat and food processing sectors. Its product lineup includes hydraulic stuffers, smokehouses, grinders, slicers, band saws, vacuum sealers, tumblers, mixers, injectors, patty molders, batter and breading systems, and a full range of supplies such as casings, seasonings, packaging materials, and cutting tools. A parts department sources components from major brands, and a service team offers scheduled maintenance and emergency after‑hours calls. The operation runs from a facility at 8064 Chivvis Drive that houses a test kitchen and demonstration lab, serving customers within a 150‑mile radius of St. Louis across Missouri and Illinois.

The customer base spans commercial meat processors, sausage makers, and food manufacturers producing items such as salami, summer sausage, capicola, mortadella, bologna, and pork rolls. The company does not disclose specific client names but emphasizes its coverage of the Missouri and Illinois markets.

The firm highlights its family‑owned continuity, over 80 years of industry experience, a full test kitchen for product trials, and a commitment to supplying the newest equipment at competitive prices. Emergency service availability on weekends and after hours is also promoted as a key differentiator.
